versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.2

- Clarified requirements and user flow for both wallet (x402) and non-wallet (website) users.
- Added an explicit section describing the option to direct non-crypto users to the website for monthly payments.
- Updated security notes, emphasizing that all discovery endpoints are free and noting differences in agent vs. website pricing.
- No file or functional changes; documentation improvement only.

**Security and wallet signing requirements clarified for all paid claims.**

- Explicitly requires use of an external crypto wallet (hardware, browser extension, or WalletConnect) with USDC on Base network for payment; raw private keys must never be stored or pasted.
- Agents must verify recipient address and payment facilitator URL before signing; added new instructions and warnings for payment signature security.
- Credentials section updated: No API keys needed, but external wallet signing is mandatory for paid flows.
- Coupon instructions removed for simplicity; now only mentions manual claim if external signing is unsupported.
- Emphasizes never making payments or signing without explicit user confirmation and verification on every transaction.

**Version 2.0.0 – Early Adopter Lifetime Deal & Coupon Support**

- Pins now cost a **one-time $1 per square for permanent placement**, instead of $1/month (early adopter deal for agents).
- Added support for **discount codes/coupons**, including full (100%) discounts that **bypass all payment**.
- Agents must **explicitly confirm with the user** before submitting payments or claims.
- Added new API endpoint: `/api/agent/validate-coupon/{code}` to check coupon status/discount.
- Clarified **crypto wallet** requirements for x402 payments (USDC on Base); coupons can eliminate the need for a wallet.
- Updated instructions, privacy, and data handling disclosures to reflect permanent pin policy and agent process changes.

LocalSquare-ads v1.0.0 initial release:

- Introduces an AI agent workflow for claiming local business ads on LocalSquare’s digital bulletin boards (43,000+ ZIP codes).
- Enables autonomous agents to discover, claim, and pay for ad pins for $1/month using the x402 USDC protocol—no user account or login needed.
- Businesses receive SEO-optimized web pages that appear in Google and AI search results.
- 10% of every payment is donated to a local charity chosen by the business or assigned randomly.
- Designed for ultra-low-cost, high-ROI local advertising—especially for small businesses and service providers.
